docs.title: Phishing awareness training platform
docs.text:
Welcome to the documentation of the Phishing Awareness Training Platform.

This documentation explains how to set up, use, and extend the project.

And this project is a Django-based web application desgin to help users recognize and responed to phishing attacks through interactive training scenarios.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.text:
This documentation contains four sections.

  • Tutorial - Learn how to run the project for the first time and explore the training platform.
  • How-to - Step-by-step guides for performing common development tasts.
  • Reference - Technical inaformatio about the project's structure and componemts.

docs.title: How to create a phishing training scenario
Overview
docs.text: This guide explains how to create a phishing training scenario using the Django admin panel.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before you begin, make sure:

  • The project is running.
  • You have an account with access to the Django admin panel.

docs.title: Step 1: Open the Django admin panel
docs.text:
Open:

http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin/

Sign in with an account that has access to the Django admin panel.

docs.title: Step 2 - Create a new scenario
docs.text:
Under the Training section, select Scenarios, then click Add.

Fill in the scenario details:

  • Select a Category.
  • Enter a Title.
  • Add the phishing Message.
  • Provide the scenario Content.
  • Choose whether the scenario Is phishing.
  • Select the Difficulty.
  • Set the Depth.
  • Choose the appropriate Phase.

Save the scenario.

docs.title: Step 3 - Add the scenario steps
docs.text: Open Scenarios step from the Training section and create the steps associated with the new scenario.

docs.title: Step 4 - Test the scenario
docs.text: Open the application, navigate to the scenario's category, and verify that the scenario appears in the category and behaves as expected.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This reference provides an overview of the main components of the Phishing Awareness Training Platform.

docs.title: Category
docs.text: Groups phishing training scenarios into categories such as General, Students, and IT.

docs.title: Scenario
docs.text: Represents a phishing training scenario. Each scenario belongs to a category and stores information such as the title, message, content, difficulty, and phase.

docs.title: ScenarioStep
docs.text: Represents a single step within a phishing training scenario and defines the order of the scenario flow.

docs.title: Step
docs.text: Stores the content associated with a scenario step.

docs.text:
The Django admin panel provides access to the following project resources:

  • Categories

docs.title: Run the phishing awareness training platform
Overview
docs.text: This tutorial walks you through running the Phishing Awareness Training Platform for the first time. By the end, you will have the project running locally and will be able to explore the available phishing categories and training scenarios.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before you begin, make sure you have:

  • Git
  • Python 3.11 or later
  • pip

docs.title: Step 1 - Clone the repository
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/royy92/phishing-training-platform.git
cd phishing-training-platform

docs.title: Step 2 - Install the project dependencies
docs.text:
Create and activate a virtual environment, then install the project dependencies.

python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt

docs.title: Step 3 - Apply the database migrations
docs.text: python manage.py migrate

docs.title: Step 4 - Load the example data
docs.text:
Load the example categories, scenarios, and scenario steps:

python manage.py loaddata sample_data_aligned.json

docs.title: Step 5 - Create an admin user
docs.text:
Create a superuser account so you can log in and manage the platform:

python manage.py createsuperuser

docs.title: Step 6 - Start the development server
docs.text: python manage.py runserver

docs.title: Step 7 - Open the application
docs.text:
Open your browser and navigate to:

http://127.0.0.1:8000/

docs.title: Step 8 - Explore the phishing categories
docs.text: Browse the available phishing categories from the home page.

docs.title: Step 9 - Open a category and view its phishing scenarios
docs.text: Select a category to view the avaliable phishing training scenarios and begin exploring the platform.

docs.title: 0001. Use Django for the phishing training platform
Context
docs.text: The project aims to provide a phishing awareness training platform where users can complete interactive scenarios and improve their ability to recognize phishing attacks. The application requires user authentication, database support, an administrative interface for managing training content, and a maintainable project structure. The team is small, with limited development time and limited hardware resources. The project also needs a framework that supports rapid development without implementing common web features from scratch.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text: Use Django as the web framework for the phishing training platform.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• Django provides a built-in admin interface for managing training content.
  • Built-in authentication reduces the amount of custom code.
  • Django reduces development time by providing built-in authentication, an admin interface, and database migrations.
  • Django provides a clear and maintainable project structure.
  • Contributors should have basic Django knowledge to work on the project.
  • New features should follow Django's project structure and conventions.
